historical_refusal: Current concept is documented; historical §403(f)(5) effective-date reconstruction is incomplete. Do not apply current text to earlier income years by assumption.

self_employment.reason: 411(b)(2) and(i)(2) define self-employment income;403(f)(5)(B) uses net earnings/net loss.
